d: We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Human Resources Manager to lead and oversee the full spectrum of HR functions in the United Arab Emirates (UAE).

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise across all areas of human resources, including talent acquisition, employee relations, performance management, compensation and benefits, payroll, HR policies, regulatory compliance, and organizational development.

The HR Manager will play a key role in developing and implementing effective HR strategies, ensuring compliance with UAE Labour Law and applicable government regulations, strengthening employee engagement, and aligning HR practices with the organization's business objectives.

This role requires a hands-on professional with strong leadership, strategic thinking, and operational capabilities who can manage day-to-day HR activities while driving continuous improvement across the organization.
Lead the end-to-end recruitment process, including workforce planning, job postings, candidate sourcing, interviewing, selection, and offer negotiation.
Develop and implement effective recruitment strategies to attract, hire, and retain high-quality talent.
Partner with department heads to identify staffing needs and ensure timely fulfillment of vacancies.
Oversee onboarding, orientation, and integration programs for new employees.
Ensure recruitment practices comply with UAE employment regulations and applicable Emiratisation requirements.
Oversee all HR operations, including employee records, employment contracts, HR documentation, personnel files, and employee lifecycle management.
Develop, implement, and maintain HR policies, procedures, and internal guidelines in line with business requirements and UAE Labour Law.
Ensure the accuracy, confidentiality, and proper maintenance of employee data and HR systems.
Manage employee joining, transfers, promotions, resignations, terminations, and final settlements.
Streamline HR processes to improve operational efficiency and service delivery.
Ensure proper documentation and administration of employee leave, attendance, and other HR-related matters.
Manage and oversee monthly payroll processing, ensuring accuracy, confidentiality, and timely salary disbursement.
Ensure compliance with the UAE Wage Protection System (WPS), where applicable.
Administer employee compensation, benefits, allowances, annual leave entitlements, gratuity, and other employment-related payments.
Coordinate with Finance to ensure accurate payroll reconciliation, budgeting, and reporting.
Manage end-of-service benefits calculations in accordance with UAE Labour Law.
Oversee employee medical insurance and other applicable benefits.
Review compensation structures and benefits programs to support employee retention and market competitiveness.
UAE Labour Law and Regulatory Compliance
Ensure compliance with UAE Labour Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 33 of 2021, as amended) and its implementing regulations.
Oversee HR-related government processes and platforms, including:
Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation (MOHRE).
General Pension and Social Security Authority (GPSSA), where applicable.
Federal Authority for Identity, Citizenship, Customs and Port Security (ICP).
General Directorate of Residency and Foreigners Affairs (GDRFA), where applicable.
Relevant free zone authorities and government portals.
Monitor employment contracts, work permits, residency visas, Emirates ID documentation, and other regulatory obligations.
Ensure compliance with Emiratisation targets and applicable government initiatives.
Monitor changes in UAE employment regulations and implement necessary policy and process updates.
Manage HR audits, documentation, and compliance reporting to minimize legal and operational risks.
Ensure compliance with applicable occupational health, safety, and workplace requirements.
Manage employee relations matters, including grievances, disciplinary actions, workplace conflicts, and employee concerns.
Provide guidance and support to managers on employee performance, disciplinary procedures, and HR-related matters.
Develop and implement performance management systems, including annual appraisals, performance reviews, and development plans.
Promote a positive workplace culture that supports employee engagement, productivity, and retention.
Ensure fair, consistent, and professional handling of employee relations issues.
Identify employee development needs and coordinate training and professional development initiatives.
Identify training needs across departments and develop annual training and development plans.
Coordinate employee training programs to enhance skills, competencies, and overall performance.
Support succession planning, talent development, and career progression initiatives.
Develop initiatives to improve employee engagement, motivation, and organizational effectiveness.
Support organizational restructuring and change management initiatives when required.
Develop and execute HR strategies aligned with the organization's business goals and growth plans.
Advise senior management on workforce planning, organizational structure, employee productivity, and people-related challenges.
Establish and monitor HR key performance indicators (KPIs), including recruitment timelines, turnover, retention, absenteeism, and employee engagement.
Prepare HR reports, headcount analysis, and workforce forecasts to support informed management decisions.
Monitor HR budgets and manpower costs in coordination with Finance.
Lead continuous improvement initiatives to enhance HR effectiveness and organizational performance.
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
Minimum of 5–8 years of progressive HR experience, with proven experience in a managerial or senior HR role.
Strong, hands-on knowledge of the full HR lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, payroll, compensation and benefits, employee relations, performance management, and HR administration.
Demonstrated experience developing and implementing HR policies, procedures, and strategic initiatives.
Solid knowledge of UAE Labour Law, employment regulations, and relevant government HR systems.
Practical experience dealing with MOHRE, WPS, visa processing, work permits, and other relevant UAE government platforms.
Good understanding of Emiratisation requirements and applicable employment regulations.
Proven ability to lead recruitment activities, improve talent acquisition strategies, and support workforce planning.
Experience managing payroll, employee benefits, end-of-service benefits, HR documentation, and employee records with a high degree of accuracy and confidentiality.
Demonstrated ability to train, coach, and advise managers and employees on HR policies, performance management, and employee relations.
Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, sound judgment, and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work with a multicultural workforce.
Strategic thinking combined with a hands-on approach to HR management.
Strong knowledge of UAE employment practices and regulatory requirements.
Strong decision-making skills and the ability to handle confidential and sensitive matters professionally.
Ability to work effectively with senior management, department heads, and employees at all levels.
A proactive mindset with a focus on process improvement, compliance, and employee experience.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving business environment.
Strong leadership, problem-solving, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills.
High level of professionalism, integrity, and accountability.
POST: Secondary Teacher of English and English Literature at Safa Community School, January Start, Dubai

Safa Community School - a beacon of excellence. In 2024, we were honoured with the ‘Happiest School in the UAE’ title, a testament to our commitment towards student well-being. In addition, we were proud recipients of the ‘Value Add, Leaving No Child Behind Award’, reflecting our dedication to academic progress. This was further underscored by our GCSE VA score of +2.2. Our high staff retention rates and inclusion in the top 15 Schools in the UAE by the Schoolscompared.com survey are a source of pride for us all.

At Safa Community School, we are more than just a school-we are a community. With a parent body comprising Expats, including around 35% from the UK, we have fostered a reputation for being a friendly, warm, and community-oriented school. Our positive relationships among staff, parents, and students are a testament to our inclusive approach, making everyone feel welcomed and part of a larger family. This sense of belonging sets us apart and should make you feel at home in our school.

Safa Community School is not just another school but an award-winning all-through UK curriculum school, from FS1 to Year 13, with 2,640. Follow our school Instagram channel for a glimpse into our vibrant community showcasing student achievements, community events, and much more at safa_scs. Discover how we nurture talent, foster creativity, and build a thriving environment for every student.
Currently, we are in search of a dynamic and passionate English and English Literature Teacher (secondary school) to join our highly accomplished secondary department.
The successful candidate would be expected to teach across the age and ability range, GCSE and A-Level.
This role is being advertised as part of our strategic growth to meet increasing student enrollment and programme demand.
q: Must have experience teaching in British Curriculum schools, teaching of both IGCSE and A level.
Most importantly should be enthusiastic about the subject and be able to convey this to students.
Have an understanding of assessment and examination requirements for KS3, KS4 and KS5.
Be an outstanding teacher with the ability to demonstrate outstanding practice and progress of students.
Works effectively as part of a team.
Actively keeps up to date with the developments in their subject.
Has a willingness to develop as a professional, taking opportunities to train further within the department, or outside to progress in their career.
This job description will be reviewed regularly and may be subject to modification and amendment.
Closing date for applications is Monday, 30th November 2026 at 10h00 UAE time.
All applications must be submitted on the TES/Schrole Portal. Only applications submitted through the Portal will be considered.
Only applications with experience teaching GCSE's and A-Levels will be considered.
Submit an up to date, full resume / CV.
Submit a covering letter of no more than two A4 pages.
Provide at least three referees’ names, telephone numbers (with international dialling codes), and email addresses. One must be a current employer.
The closing date for all applications is Tuesday, 17th February 2026 at 10h00 UAE time.

Applications will be assessed in order of receipt and interviews may occur at any stage after applications are received. We reserve the right to appoint before the closing date and therefore invite interested candidates to apply as soon as possible.
Once initial interviews are concluded, arrangements will be made individually with those candidates who will proceed to the second round of interviews.
A demonstration lesson will be required.
Upon request, feedback will only be provided to candidates who progress to the interview stages.
Role Level: Not Applicable Work Type: Full-Time Country: United Arab Emirates City: Dubai Company Website: http://www.safacommunityschool.com Job Function: Education & Teaching Company Industry/

The professional duties of a teacher shall be deemed to include the following duties:
li

Teaching, including planning and preparing courses and lessons, setting and marking of work and assessing, recording and reporting on the development, progress and attainment in line with the school’s expectations and policy.
li
Using data to inform classroom teaching, monitoring and tracking student progress and putting in place timely interventions.
li

Preparing students for public examinations, assessing students for the purposes of such examinations, recording and reporting such assessments and attending meetings connected with the conduct of public examinations.
li
Communicating and consulting with the parents of students, including the writing of reports.
li
Attendance at Parents’ Evenings and Open Evenings.
li
Maintaining good order and discipline among the students he/she is teaching.
li
Participating in departmental meetings and Open Evenings.
li

Working as a member of a team in the shaping of departmental policy and practice, the introduction of curricular initiatives, the preparation and development of programmes of study and methods of teaching and assessment.
li
Participating in administrative and organisational tasks in order to ensure the smooth running of the department.
li
Keeping up to date with curriculum innovation, participating in arrangements for CPD, contributing to his/her own professional development.
li
Working collaboratively with support teachers in the classroom.
li
Taking responsibility for the monitoring and support of a beginning teacher taking his/her class, if appropriate.
li
Setting work for his/her classes where absence is known in advance and setting work for absent colleagues where required.
li
Taking responsibility for a designated area of the curriculum, administration or curriculum innovation or project.
li
Carrying out other tasks as reasonably directed by the Head of Department.
li
Familiarising themselves with the DSIB inspection framework and the expectations of outstanding teaching and learning in the UAE.
li
Being supportive of UAE initiatives and cultural expectations.
